newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - British Petroleum hovers.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - British Petroleum hovers.

text.p: British Petroleum Plc, one of the few stocks trading in the after-hours session, fell to 141 after it closed down 3-7/8 at 141-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange, dealers said Wednesday.
"I don't see much right now," said one of them.
The British oil company had its stock halted for an imbalance minutes before the close of normal trading hours. It resumed trading about 15 minutes afterwards.
MOSCOM Corp was trading at 3-15/16 from a Nasdaq close of 3-31/32 following news that it expected a substantial write-off in the second quarter as part of a restructuring.
Intel Corp was trading slightly higher at 153-1/8 from a close of 152-3/4, while IBM Corp was in line with its 174-1/4 closing price.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 6,200 shares against 45,600 the previous day. Session two had 6.2 million shares against 1.6 million, it said.
